ld2410c_init.message0: %1 connect soft serial RX pin %2 TX pin %3 baud rate %4
ld2410c_init.tooltip: Create an LD2410C radar object and initialize the soft serial (module TX to RX pin, module RX to TX pin)

ld2410c_read_frame.tooltip: Receive bytes from the soft serial, align on header (244 243 242 241) and delimit by tail (248 247 246 245), and store the latest frame (23 bytes in basic mode, up to 45 in engineering mode). Non-blocking; call repeatedly in the loop

ld2410c_new_frame.tooltip: Whether a new frame has just been received and stored (flag clears automatically after reading)

ld2410c_frame_valid.tooltip: Stays true from the first valid frame (level signal, no auto-clear)

ld2410c_frame_byte.tooltip: Read byte 1 to frame length of the stored frame (header, data section and tail included)

ld2410c_data_byte.tooltip: Read byte 1 to data section length of the stored frame's data section (data section = frame length - 8)

ld2410c_frame_length.tooltip: Returns the actual stored frame length: 23-45 bytes (0 when no valid frame stored)

ld2410c_data_length.tooltip: Returns the actual data section length: = frame length - 8 (15 bytes in basic mode; 0 when no valid frame stored)

ld2410c_mode.tooltip: Frame byte 7: 1 = engineering report, 2 = basic report

ld2410c_target_status.tooltip: Frame byte 9: 0 = no target, 1 = moving, 2 = static, 3 = moving + static

ld2410c_moving_distance.tooltip: Raw moving target distance, frame bytes 10-11, 16-bit little-endian

ld2410c_static_distance.tooltip: Raw static target distance, frame bytes 13-14, 16-bit little-endian

ld2410c_detect_distance.tooltip: Raw overall detection distance, frame bytes 16-17, 16-bit little-endian

ld2410c_move_gate_count.tooltip: Number of moving detection gates, frame byte 18; engineering frames only (0 in basic frames)

ld2410c_static_gate_count.tooltip: Number of static detection gates, frame byte 19; engineering frames only (0 in basic frames)

ld2410c_move_gate_energy.tooltip: Energy 0-100 of moving gate 1-9, frame bytes 20-28; engineering frames only

ld2410c_static_gate_energy.tooltip: Energy 0-100 of static gate 1-9, frame bytes 29-37; engineering frames only

ld2410c_photosensitive.tooltip: Ambient light value 0-255, frame byte 38; engineering frames only (0 in basic frames)

ld2410c_poll_auto.tooltip: Automatically alternates listening among all initialized LD2410C radar objects: switches to the next one after a complete frame arrives or after 500 ms without one. Call repeatedly in the loop and read values with each object's parsing blocks; a separate read block is not needed
